title: Templates for this module
body: Copy-ready structures you can reuse in your own engagements. Examples are fictional.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Use case, interviewee/role, recent example, trigger, steps, systems, handoffs, time/frequency, failure, consequence, metric source, unknowns

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Walk through the most recent case: where did you look, what blocked you, how did you judge the answer, and who can verify the timing?

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: Representative users; estimates distinguished from observation; privacy and recording rules followed.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: State, step #, actor, trigger/input, action, system/source, active min, wait min, frequency, output, failure/exception, human control, evidence, dependency

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: Current: search wiki 8 min estimated. Future: retrieve approved guidance with source review; duration unvalidated until test.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: No unsupported deletion of controls; active and elapsed time distinct.
